<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Retch Rust](/Feats.aspx?ID=4260) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 31

</column>

---

You exhale tendrils formed from flakes of rusted metal. All creatures in a 30-foot cone take 4d10 slashing damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save against your class DC. A metal creature that fails its save also takes 2d4 [persistent slashing damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).

---
**Level (+2)** The cloud's slashing damage increases by 1d10 and the persistent damage increases by 1d4.
name: Retch Rust
